note: v1502: Two agent tests went red on CI after v1499 and stayed green on the Mac, because both are browser-driven and browser tests SKIP on this machine - Chrome dump-dom never answers over loopback here. The fresh-PC test asserted the route says windows, but v1499 replaced the route vocabulary with owner and guest; its promise, that an unclaimed machine starts empty, is unchanged and now reads guest. The four-worlds test drove the router by setting D2R_MACHINE, which v1499 no longer reads, so every key came back as undefined plus the name; it now drives the resolved prefixes exactly as every other surface consumes them. Verified with Playwright, which can do loopback: the 2x2 resolves bare, L, W and WL as expected and a UI preference stays bare in all four.
